asset.name: AnimatedNumber
asset.description: The locale-aware numeric transition interpolating values while preserving formatting, handling large jumps sensibly, and announcing only the settled value.

requires.reason: Every spacing, size, and radius value resolves to a declared ramp rather than a literal.
Motion policy is resolved through the shared hook so the preference can be overridden and tested.
Formatting, grouping, and decimal separators are locale-specific.

rationale: Announcing every intermediate frame is the defect here: a counter that speaks each interpolated value makes a screen reader unusable, so announcement is bound to the settled value only.
